name: Split Pea Soup
author: Grandma Phelps (Shorty)
steps: Cover peas with 2 quarts cold water and soak overnight (or simmer gently 21 minutes, then soak 1 hour this is what I do).
add ham bone, onion, and seasonings.
Bring to boiling; cover reduce heat, and simmer (don't boil) 1 1/2 hours.
Remove bone; cut off meat and dice.
Return meat to soup, add vegetables.
Cook slowly, uncovered 30 to 40 minutes, I usually cook it another hour or more until it thickens.
